Name: TimeSpeed
Author: cantorsdust
Description:
This mod lets you control the flow of time in the game: speed it up, slow it down, or freeze it altogether. This can happen automatically or when you press a key in the game.

[b][color=#6aa84f]For non-English players, translations are included in the base mod. [url=https://github.com/cantorsdust/StardewMods#translating-the-mods]Contributions are welcome[/url]![/color][/b]

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]Use[/size][/b]
You can set the default time speed(s) [url=https://github.com/cantorsdust/StardewMods/tree/develop/TimeSpeed#configure]in the mod options[/url], and it'll change automatically in-game. By default, time is a bit slower indoors.

You can also change time speed manually by pressing keyboard buttons ([url=https://github.com/cantorsdust/StardewMods/tree/develop/TimeSpeed#configure]configurable[/url]). This will reset to your configured defaults when you change location.

Default buttons:
[list]
[*][font=Courier New]N[/font]: freeze or unfreeze time. Freezing time will stay in effect until you unfreeze it; unfreezing time will stay in effect until you enter a new location with time settings.
[*][font=Courier New],[/font]: speed up time by one second per 10-game-minutes. Combine with [font=Courier New]Control[/font] to decrease by 100 seconds, [font=Courier New]Shift[/font] to decrease by 10 seconds, or [font=Courier New]Alt[/font] to decrease by 0.1 seconds.
[*][font=Courier New].[/font]: slow down time by one second per 10-game-minutes. Combine with [font=Courier New]Control[/font] to increase by 100 seconds, [font=Courier New]Shift[/font] to increase by 10 seconds, or [font=Courier New]Alt[/font] to increase by 0.1 seconds.
[*][font=Courier New]B[/font]: reload the config settings from file.
[/list]

[b][size=5]FAQs[/size][/b]
[quote][b]The time speed resets when I change location or start a new day?[/b]
That's by design. You can set the default time or per-location times [url=https://github.com/cantorsdust/StardewMods/tree/develop/TimeSpeed#configure]in the mod's configuration[/url], but it'll recalculate the time speed when you change location for that to work.[/quote][quote][b]Some things don't happen when I freeze time?[/b]
Some game features are linked to the time, so pausing time may pause those too. For the best experience, freeze time temporarily (e.g. while fishing or doing some other activity), or freeze it in the afternoon to let the main time updates happen in the morning.

Main cases:
[list]
[*]Machines and lightning update on time change, so they'll be paused while time is frozen.
[*]The train has a 20% chance to pass each day, at a random time between 9am and 5:50pm. But if time is frozen, it'll never reach the chosen time. Or if you pause time right when it's passing, a new train will continue passing each time it finishes.
[*]The chance that each pig finds a truffle is linked to the time of day. While time is frozen, each pig will either never find a truffle or find a constant supply of truffles.
[/list][/quote][quote][b]How does this work in multiplayer?[/b]
The mod must be installed by the host player to work. If farmhands install it too, they can also control the time if the host player hasn't turned that off in the mod settings.[/quote][quote][b]In the mod settings, what does "seconds per minute" mean?[/b]
Each in-game minute lasts a certain amount of real time. For example, it normally takes 7 real seconds before the in-game clock changes 10 minutes, so that's 0.7 seconds per minute.

The game's [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Day_Cycle#Passage_of_time]default time speed[/url] is:
[list]
[*]Skull Cavern: 0.9.
[*]Everywhere else: 0.7.
[/list]
Time will pass more quickly with lower values, and more slowly with higher values.[/quote][quote][b]Can I use this mod with a controller or on Android?[/b]
Yep. You can assign controller buttons in [url=https://github.com/cantorsdust/StardewMods/tree/develop/TimeSpeed#configure]the mod settings[/url], and see [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Key_Bindings#Use_key_bindings_on_Android][i]use key bindings on Android[/i][/url] for Android. You can also set the time speed in the mod settings without pressing any buttons in-game.[/quote][quote][b]Does this conflict with other mods?[/b]
Usually no. TimeSpeed should be compatible with nearly all other mods.

However, other mods which change the time speed will conflict. You should only install one time speed mod. That includes Pause Time in Multiplayer and Time Master (aka Its Stardew Time).[/quote]
[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ on Linux/Mac/Windows.
[*]Works in single-player, multiplayer, and split-screen mode.
[/list]
[b][size=5]See also[/size][/b][list][*][url=https://github.com/cantorsdust/StardewMods/blob/master/TimeSpeed/docs/release-notes.md#release-notes]Release notes[/url]
[*][url=https://github.com/cantorsdust/StardewMods]Source code[/url]
[/list]
